title: Reorganize the connection tree right-click menu
author: robertpopa22
body_snippet:
The right-click menu on the connection tree is one long list. The same commands stay. They are grouped so the row for a connection stays short.

A connection shows:

- Connect
- Connect with options
- Disconnect, only while a session is open
- Reconnect
- Duplicate, Copy, Paste, Rename, Delete
- New
- More

Paste stays on the row and is grey when the clipboard is empty.

Connect with options keeps the existing entries and also holds Clear Cached RDP Credentials.
